name: sphinx-style-notes-maker
description: Turn an unfamiliar technique in your project, a document you give, or a topic you name into a single Read the Docs-style HTML explainer page, built from your project's code and reports, the document's full text, or graded sources.

interface.shortDescription: Source-grounded HTML explainer pages with inline SVG diagrams.
interface.longDescription: Explains a technique, a package, or a chain of causes in your project, a document you give (web article, PDF, Markdown), or a topic it researches with graded sources, as one self-contained Read the Docs-style HTML page. Picks the cheapest presentation tier (static, interactive, or step-by-step animation) and confirms it with you before building.
defaultPrompt: Explain why this project uses this technique, as a webpage
Make an explainer page for what this package does and why it is designed this way
